About Us

More Than Cleaning. We Care About Your Space.

City Links Cleaning Services provides professional home and office cleaning with one simple promise: your space is treated with the same care we would give our own. A clean environment is not just about appearances — it is about comfort, health and the feeling of walking into a room that is truly fresh.

Every visit is guided by attention to detail, from the surfaces you see to the corners that are easy to overlook. We work around your routine, listen to what matters most to you, and take pride in leaving every room fresher, cleaner and more welcoming than we found it.

  • A professional approach to every home and office clean
  • Attention to detail, checked room by room
  • Cleaning plans shaped around your space and schedule
  • Customer satisfaction at the centre of every visit

Why Choose Us

The City Links Standard

Six commitments that shape every clean we deliver — for homes and workplaces alike.

Professional Cleaning Approach

A structured, methodical way of working — the right products, the right order, and a consistent finish in every room.

Attention to Detail

Skirting boards, handles, switches and corners — the details that separate a quick tidy from a truly spotless space.

Flexible Cleaning Options

Regular visits, one-off cleans and deep cleans — arranged around your schedule and the needs of your property.

Home & Office Expertise

Specialists in both residential and commercial spaces, so your home and your workplace are in equally safe hands.

Customer-Focused Service

Your priorities lead the clean. Tell us what matters most in your space and we will build the visit around it.

Reliable Service

Booked means booked. We arrive when agreed, work to the plan, and leave your space ready to enjoy or to work in.
